PROPOSAL SUMMARY
Summit Technologies proposes a premium managed IT services package with
end-to-end hardware procurement, deployment, and lifecycle management.

PRICING
Total contract value: USD 154,000 for a 12-month term, including premium
support tier and extended warranty coverage.

DELIVERY
Delivery timeline: 10 business days for standard orders; expedited 5-day
delivery available for an additional fee.

CAPABILITIES
- 24/7 support with guaranteed 1-hour response SLA for critical issues
- On-premise and cloud hosting options, hybrid deployment supported
- Full API integration suite with pre-built connectors for major HR/ERP systems
- Disaster recovery with documented RTO of 2 hours and RPO of 15 minutes
- Data encryption at rest and in transit
- Dedicated account manager and quarterly business reviews
- On-site support within 12 hours nationwide
- Multi-currency invoicing supported for international subsidiaries

COMPLIANCE AND CERTIFICATIONS
Summit Technologies holds ISO 9001:2015 certification, certificate number
ISO9001-ST-2024-7712, issued by SGS, valid until August 2027.
SOC 2 Type II audit completed in 2025, report available under NDA.
We maintain a documented GDPR compliance program with annual third-party
audits; audit certificate number GDPR-AUD-ST-2025-114, issued by an
accredited EU auditor, valid until June 2026.

WARRANTY
All hardware covered by 3-year extended warranty with next-business-day
on-site replacement. Software license includes lifetime critical patching.

REFERENCES
Three enterprise references available, including two Fortune 500 regional
subsidiaries.
